notes.title: September 2024 Update
notes.notes:
Hey lovely,

In this update we fixed a couple of issues:
1. Multiplayer avatar issues
2. Multiplayer start new game issues

More updates will follow up, thank you!

notes.title: IMPORTANT: We are improving the game!
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We wanna thank you for every single time you strike the pins in CLASHBOWL!

We are loyal to you and we are aware that there are some issues with the game.

That's why, here's what to expect on the next game update:

1. We gonna fix the internet connection issues (it's our fault, not yours!)

2. We gonna reduce the build size (you will be able to decide what maps to keep and which not)

3. We gonna fix the multiplayer issues (you will see the lobbies, be able to better match with your friends, etc).

4. We improve the UI to look much better for both VR and Keyboard.

5. We gonna improve the settings and allow you do your own key bindings.

Please keep in mind that we are making this game out of pure love for you.

We made no profit so far with it.

You can always keep in touch with us on Discord:

https://discord.gg/9DXzhAqcrP

Thank you so much,
Eduard

notes.title: NEW: Ball Hook Fixed & Cross Platform Multiplayer!
notes.notes:
Yeah, we fixed the ball hook!

We fixed the multiplayer feature!

And now you can also play multiplayer with players from other platforms!

Enjoy!

notes.title: NEW: VOICE COMMENTATOR AND ACHIEVEMENTS ADDED!
notes.notes:
You will now hear various voices when you strike!

You can also achieve milestones in the game!

Soon we will integrate achievements with Steam.

Thank you,
Eduard

notes.title: NEW: You Can Now Finally Enjoy The Power of Ray Tracing!
notes.notes:
All venues are now supporting Ray Tracing!

And they look amazing!

So why don't give them a shot?

In the near future, we gonna implement also Path Tracing (not supported in game now)

But until Path Tracing will be on...

Enjoy the 36 bowling venues with Ray Tracing!

Thank you so much for your support!
Eduard

notes.title: NEW: BOWL ON 36 UNIQUE COOL VENUES!
notes.notes:
Yes, that's right!

Now all 36 venues are available!

And major bug fixes!

We don't like to write much so update CLASHBOWL and play them all!

P.S. This new update is around 50GB

Thank you,
Eduard

Thank you,
Eduard
